main.remarks: Represents the outer signed-envelope metadata surfaced by .

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create an empty access-key signature descriptor.

property.name: Signed
property.summary: True when the outer access-key envelope carries a signature block; otherwise false.

property.name: SignerToolID
property.summary: Tool identifier claimed by the outer signature metadata.

property.name: SignerAccessManagerID
property.summary: Issuing access-manager identifier claimed by the outer signature metadata.

property.name: Algorithm
property.summary: Signature algorithm declared by the outer signature metadata.

property.name: SignerKeyIDFormat
property.summary: Format discriminator for the signer key identifier.

property.name: SignerKeyID
property.summary: Signer key identifier bytes exactly as stored in the outer signature metadata.
